probes.name: Strict parameterized filtering on conversation_id ($2::uuid) and user_id ($3::uuid)
probes.details: Verified findRelevantTurns binds both conversation_id and user_id as parameterized SQL placeholders ($2::uuid and $3::uuid), preventing cross-tenant vector retrieval.

probes.name: Zero dynamic string interpolation in Prisma raw SQL queries
probes.details: Verified no JavaScript template string interpolations (${...}) exist inside $queryRawUnsafe or $executeRawUnsafe in AiMemoryService.

probes.name: Multi-tenant isolation prevents cross-tenant turn retrieval
probes.details: Verified user-1 cannot retrieve turns from user-2 conversation conv-2. Query returned 0 rows.

probes.name: Local embedding output guarantees strictly numerical vector serialization
probes.details: Vector serialization produced 384 strictly numerical floating point values without any unescaped characters.

probes.name: AiMemoryService.indexTurn strictly parameterizes messageId, conversationId, userId, and vector
probes.details: Verified indexTurn binds $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::vector via parameterized values.

probes.name: IDOR prevention on proposal acceptance via updateMany userId predicate
probes.details: Verified user-B cannot accept user-A proposal. Throws ConflictException due to updateMany count === 0.

probes.name: IDOR prevention on proposal rejection via updateMany userId predicate
probes.details: Verified user-B cannot reject user-A proposal. Throws ConflictException due to updateMany count === 0.

probes.name: Atomic status check prevents double-acceptance race conditions
probes.details: First acceptance atomically transitions PENDING -> ACCEPTED; subsequent or concurrent call receives count 0 and throws ConflictException.

probes.name: Draft page ownership enforced on proposal creation
probes.details: Verified createProposal checks draftPages.findFirst({ where: { id: pageId, userId } }), blocking cross-user proposal creation.

probes.name: Secondary page ownership validation inside acceptProposal transaction
probes.details: Verified acceptProposal verifies draftPages ownership within the transaction before applying AST changes.

probes.name: GeminiProvider never outputs GEMINI_API_KEY to NestJS Logger
probes.details: Verified GeminiProvider logs only response status, sanitized error messages, or masked config warnings; apiKey is never interpolated into logger arguments.

probes.name: API errors and network exceptions are handled with fallback, preventing stack/URL exposure
probes.details: Verified fetch exceptions are caught inside GeminiProvider.chatWithTools and fallback responses returned, preventing unhandled exceptions from exposing API URLs or stack traces.

probes.name: AiChatDto strictly enforces 50,000 character limits on message and pageContext
probes.details: Validated class-validator @MaxLength(50000) constraint rejects 50,001 characters and accepts 50,000 characters for both message and pageContext.

overflowMessageError.maxLength: message must be shorter than or equal to 50000 characters

overflowContextError.maxLength: pageContext must be shorter than or equal to 50000 characters

probes.name: AiEditDto and AiGenerateDto enforce 50,000 character bounds
probes.details: Verified all AI transform and generation DTOs strictly enforce 50,000 character maximums against memory exhaustion and token DoS.

probes.name: Background memory indexing promises attach explicit .catch() handlers
probes.details: Verified both userMessage and assistantMessage asynchronous indexTurn calls attach .catch() logging errors, preventing process crashes on unhandled promise rejection.

probes.name: AiMemoryService.indexTurn encapsulates execution within try/catch
probes.details: Verified indexTurn internally catches and logs errors when embedding generation or database execution fails, returning safely.

probes.name: Resistance to prototype pollution attacks during ProseMirror AST traversal
probes.details: Verified AST text replacement uses object spread without polluting Object.prototype.

probes.name: Malicious HTML / Script tags in suggestedText remain passive string data in text nodes
probes.details: Verified that injected script and HTML tags are stored strictly as text node string literals without mutating node types or injecting DOM tree structures.

probes.name: Stack safety and recursion limit resistance under deeply nested AST hierarchy (100 levels)
probes.details: Handled 100 levels of nested AST blockquotes without stack overflow or recursion failure.

probes.name: Audit JavaScript String.prototype.replace special pattern evaluation ($&, $')
probes.details: Observation: String.prototype.replace(string, string) expands $& to the matched substring ("100 dollars"). For pure literal string substitution invariant to special dollar syntax, using a functional replacer () => suggestedText is recommended.

evidence.resultingText: I requested $1,000 & 100 dollars matching grant for scholarship.
